title: Synergistic botanical composition comprising Boswellia serrata and Commiphora mukul for inflammatory joint diseases
text: A synergistic anti-arthritic oral composition combining standardized 3-O-acetyl-11-keto-beta-boswellic acid (AKBA >= 30%) with guggulsterones E and Z (>= 2.5%) from Commiphora mukul, significantly inhibiting joint swelling and pro-inflammatory TNF-alpha in adjuvant-induced arthritis models.
